verdict.rationale: Gumroad's llms.txt documents OAuth plus MCP for agents to act on a connected creator's account. That is a first-party, agent-specific delegated credential rather than a shared password, but nothing shows the token can be restricted to particular permissions. missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or permission granularity, per-agent token issuance and revocation controls, read-only versus write separation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
